{#- A single flex-laid-out group for the icon(s) + search box, instead of independently absolute-positioned children guessing each other's width -- that's what let the repo-link icon overlap the search input at some viewport widths. The group itself takes base.css's usual `body > nav form` slot (bottom:0; right:0); the form is de-positioned back to static so it participates in the flex row instead of also trying to self-place. #}
{#- Inline SVGs, not icon-font glyphs: avoids pulling in Font Awesome (or any icon font) just for two marks. Acid Genomics' vial mark (Font Awesome's free "vial" glyph, same one r.acidgenomics.com's pkgdown nav uses) links to acidgenomics.com; "octicon-mark-github" is the path GitHub itself ships for its own logo. #} {%- if theme_repo_url %} {%- endif %}
